define performance dimensions, budgets, measurement environments and deterministic evidence needed for an acceptance claim
define interoperability matrix across completed MAI schemas, adapters, resolver/workbench and owner-integration outputs
define negative/degraded/unsupported corpus cases and fail-closed acceptance behavior
define cross-platform Linux/Windows deterministic comparison and any additional performance/corpus artifacts needed beyond Validation Core receipts

selection_contract.authority_rule: Selection authorizes planning resolution only. No performance threshold, corpus membership, benchmark result or interoperability acceptance is assumed before governed start and evidence.
selection_contract.owner_rule: MAI-10 proof may measure and validate MAI behavior but may not replace MIB-11/D18, A5 Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions, Combat/Exploration, Action or D29 owner truth.
selection_contract.provider_rule: No provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment or vendor-specific canonicalization is authorized by selection.

preserved_boundaries: MAI-01..09 completed_verified with exact evidence preserved and no further implementation authority
MAI-10 selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority
no vendor/editor/provider or asset pack is canonical or assumed complete
unknown/denied/revoked permission remains ineligible and visibly-unresolved assignment cannot activate
MAI-09 integration receipts remain orchestration evidence rather than owner truth
MIB-11/D18, A5 Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions, Combat/Exploration and D29 retain canonical authority
